festsnap.title: Festsnap
festsnap.description: A full-stack SaaS platform that lets event guests contribute photos to a shared gallery through a simple upload form, giving event owners a centralized, privacy-protected collection of every moment.
highlights: Dual onboarding: self-serve signup with a free trial, plus a B2B flow for venues to provision events on behalf of clients
Owner-centric gallery: bulk download, album organization and one-click PDF export
Privacy-first: uploaded images are visible only to the event owner
Scalable media pipeline: decoupled microservices process images asynchronously, load-tested to 1,000 uploads/second on a 4GB RAM server

danzo.title: Danzo Visuals
danzo.description: Portfolio website for Danzo Visuals, a professional video and photography studio: multilingual (EN / AL / DE), services, portfolio, media and booking via WhatsApp.

valleyFestival.title: Valley Film Festival
valleyFestival.description: The official multi-language website of an international film festival in the Presevo Valley, serving as the event's public program and archive hub.
highlights: Full site in English, Albanian and Serbian with locale-based routing
Film lineup with metadata and a day-by-day schedule filterable by venue and event type
Guest showcase, event gallery and partners sections
Content-driven architecture with reusable templates for year-over-year editions

aiQuiz.title: AI Quiz Generator
aiQuiz.description: An AI-powered platform that creates quizzes on demand from any topic or text, using the OpenAI API to generate questions, answer options and explanations.
highlights: Real-time mode: generates questions on the fly during a live session
Standard mode: generates a complete quiz set upfront for self-paced taking
